risk_classes.name: local_capture
risk_classes.required_gate: visible local state and device attribution

risk_classes.name: proposal

risk_classes.name: sensitive_or_identity_write

risk_classes.name: external_or_system_effect
risk_classes.required_gate: outside Workspace Phase 0 and structurally absent from Doc

capability_ladder.name: background_work
